executionOrder: Final benchmark completed before the full regression suite started.
coverage: Complete fragmented long frames, final partial frames, CRLF and byte-fragmented UTF-8
Parser/tail disposal, including disposal from inside a frame callback
30 local TCP readiness cycles with startup listeners removed and stderr still draining
Startup failure diagnostics and real child termination on timeout
Offline SSH exact-limit output, independent stdout/stderr byte overflow and Unicode output

limits: Synthetic framing and retained-heap measurements plus local offline integration tests. No whole-app Electron RAM, packaged-platform, real SSH deployment or model/VRAM performance claim.
